body.heading: Where in the world is Sri Lanka?
paragraphs: Sri Lanka is a country in Southern Asia, which is part of Asia. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Sri Lanka is Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte. Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte is the legislative capital, where parliament meets. Colombo, the big seaport city nearby, is where the president and the courts work.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Sri Lanka speak Sinhala and Tamil.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Sri Lanka is the Sri Lankan rupee.

body.heading: How big is Sri Lanka?
paragraphs: Sri Lanka covers about 66,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Tajikistan.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Sigiriya is a royal palace built on top of a giant rock column. Climb past ancient paintings and between two huge lion's paws to the summit gardens.
The train ride through Sri Lanka's tea country — past waterfalls, tea pickers and the famous Nine Arch Bridge — is called one of the most beautiful rail journeys in the world.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Sri Lanka on a map or globe. Which continent is it nearest to — and what sea or ocean surrounds it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
